name: YMCA Youth and Government (Model Legislature and Court)
what_you_do: You go to weekly local meetings. At in-person conferences in November and February, you act as a lawmaker, lawyer or judge.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 9 to 12 from anywhere in California. Join a local group. Silicon Valley groups list ages 14 to 18.
pay_detail: $1,500 for the 2026-27 YMCA of Silicon Valley delegations. Other areas do not post a fee; ask your local YMCA about cost and scholarships.
duration: Weekly meetings plus conferences in November and February
deadline_text: Sign-up dates are not stated on the page. Silicon Valley delegations run from about Sept 2026 to March 2027. A conference is planned for November, so ask now.
how_to_apply: There are two ways to reach the program. Southern California: call the director at (626) 604-4210 or use the form on the YMCA of Orange County site. Silicon Valley area: click 'Register Today' on the YMCA of Silicon Valley Leadership Development page. Or use the interest form linked here. Neither page lists the steps to apply.
notes: Over 1,300 teens in more than 60 California delegations. The YMCA of Orange County page (Southern California) lists no Northern California contact. The YMCA of Silicon Valley lists the same statewide program and links a sign-up form for the Silicon Valley area. Ask the director which delegation serves your area, and ask about cost and scholarships. The YMCA of Silicon Valley Leadership Development page also lists other teen groups and a Model UN program for middle school students; they are not part of this entry.
